title: smtp: secretx credential failure is warn-not-exit, server starts uncredentialed
description: smtp/src/server.rs uses warn!() and continues when any secretx step fails (invalid URI, retrieval error, non-UTF-8 content). All other callers (mail/main.rs, reader/store/server_stores.rs, transit/main.rs) treat secretx errors as fatal and exit(1). In smtp, if auth.credential_file is a secretx: URI and the retrieval fails, the daemon starts with an empty credential store. If AUTH is required or expected, all SMTP clients will be rejected silently — the admin sees only a WARN log, not a crash.
